name: Smart Site Health Monitor
author: meetupadhyay

sections.description:
Smart Site Health Monitor gives you a clear, real-time health score for your WordPress site. It automatically scans for the most common problems that slow down and break WordPress sites — plugin conflicts, outdated software, database bloat, and PHP issues — and shows you exactly what to fix.

Why you need this

Most WordPress problems come from a small set of causes: two plugins fighting each other, an outdated plugin with a security hole, a bloated database slowing every page load, or a PHP configuration that’s too limited. This plugin surfaces all of those in one simple dashboard.

What it checks

Plugin Health
* Detects conflicts between commonly conflicting plugins (multiple caching plugins, multiple SEO plugins, multiple security scanners, etc.)
* Lists all plugins with available updates, color-coded by severity (security update vs. feature update)
* Shows count of inactive plugins

PHP & WordPress Health
* PHP version check with recommendations
* Memory limit and current usage with visual bar
* Max execution time check
* WP_DEBUG and display_errors status
* WordPress core update availability

Database Health
* Total database size and overhead
* Autoloaded options size (a very common cause of slow admin)
* Post revisions count
* Spam comments count
* Expired transients count
* Database table issue detection (crashed tables, excessive overhead)
* Performance issue detection for large postmeta and usermeta tables

Key features

  • Health Score (0–100) — A single score calculated from all checks so you can see your site’s health at a glance
  • Dashboard Widget — See your health score right on the WordPress admin home screen
  • One-click scan — Run a full scan any time with one click, no configuration needed
  • Admin notice — Automatically alerts you when your score drops below 60/100
  • Color-coded issues — Red for critical, yellow for warnings, blue for informational
  • Zero configuration — Works immediately after activation, no setup required
  • Clean uninstall — Removes all data when you delete the plugin

Privacy

This plugin does not collect or send any data to external servers. All scans run locally on your server.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/smart-site-health-monitor/, or install directly from the WordPress plugin directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Site Health in the admin menu
  4. Click Scan Now to run your first health check
sections.faq:
How long does a scan take?

A typical scan takes 5–20 seconds depending on your server speed and database size.

Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. The scan only runs when you click “Scan Now” — it never runs automatically on frontend page loads. Results are cached after each scan.

What do the colors mean?

  • Red — Critical issue that needs immediate attention (security risk or major performance problem)
  • Yellow — Warning that should be reviewed soon
  • Blue — Informational issue with low impact

What is the health score based on?

The score starts at 100 and deductions are made for each issue found: plugin conflicts (−8 to −15 points each), security-level outdated plugins (−8), PHP issues (−6 to −12), database overhead (−10), and so on.

Does this plugin fix issues automatically?

The free version identifies issues and links you to the right place to fix them. It does not automatically modify your site.

Will this conflict with other health/monitoring plugins?

Smart Site Health Monitor is read-only — it only reads data and never modifies other plugins. It is safe to use alongside any other plugin.

Is it compatible with multisite?

The plugin is designed for single-site installations. Multisite support is planned for a future version.
